name: pickup_handle_pkt12_airdrop_spawn_chute_relay
description: Pickup::HandlePkt12_AirdropSpawnChuteRelay applies an incoming airdrop spawn relay by adopting the packet next-pickup id and spawning the requested pickup type at the packet position. Direct production host: RecoilApp.cpp.
known_limits: The smoke target verifies the packet next-pickup id side effect through the handler. The spawn dispatch is source-matched from Binary Ninja and covered by the accepted Pickup::SpawnWithAirdropChute functional target.
tier S verification was not attempted in this session. Final byte matching should be handled with the coherent Pickup packet-handler/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4340a0 validates reading packet->nextPickupId at offset 0x18, calling Pickup::SetNextPickupId, reading the unsigned 16-bit pickupTypeIndex at offset 0x14, passing packet->spawnPos at offset 0x08 to Pickup::SpawnWithAirdropChute, and returning 1.
The native smoke verifies the handler returns 1 and updates g_NextPickupId from the packet while using an invalid pickup type to keep the spawn helper on its no-object path.
